svg.title: TOPAK E1 — Observer topology: one observer seat per cell, a correlator across cells, and W(p) is the ACL
svg.desc: ADR-0038 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.29, Batch 13, confirmation required C3 and C4) supersedes ADR-0008: the shared Observer group becomes the correlator with a narrower job, each cell gets its own Observer, placement keeps ADR-0008's colocation rule on fault-domain grounds, and Observers combine by any-of with no quorum. Every finding is still deny-only (ADR-0007): nothing here touches the admit path.
svg.text: TOPAK · E1

text.tspan: seat per cell, a correlator across cells, and

svg.text: ADR-0038 (Accepted (genesis) 2026.09.29, Batch 13, confirmation required C3 and C4) supersedes ADR-0008: the shared Observer group becomes the correlator with a narrower job, each cell gets its own Observer, placement keeps ADR-0008's colocation rule on fault-domain grounds, and Observers combine by any-of with no quorum. Every finding is still deny-only (ADR-0007): nothing here touches
the admit path.
ADR-0008's colocation rule is carried forward (§4); its scoping and its instance economics (about 9 shared instances against about 40 per-agent) are replaced.
Thinker t1, a thinker seat: a principal with its own
lease, round topic and Persona (ADR-0037 §1).
Reaches the world only through admits.
Reader stage: not a seat, no Persona (ADR-0037 §2). Its
two facts, conformance verdict and distributional distance,
go to every seat in W(p) (R1). May colocate (§4).
Cell Observer o1: an observer seat with cell = t1 (
SeatDecl.cell).
Reads t1's round topic in full, payloads included, under
the ACL; the Actuate envelope's four label fields; and is
given t1's tool list from the round's opening record
Compromise costs one cell's detection.
Lineage from a different model family than t1
(monoculture rule).

text.tspan: device C (not shared with any member of W(p))

svg.text: One or more observer seats that belong to no cell (SeatDecl.cell empty). ADR-0008's shared group
under a new name, with a narrower job: cross-cell detection only.
Its round is a correlation window the deployment declares, leased and topic-scoped; its state across
windows is its own derived store (finding 3).
A finding may name any principal in its domain: the one thing a cell Observer cannot do. Still deny-only.
Compromise costs cross-cell detection only; every cell Observer still works. It reads every cell's payloads,
so it is the one place an injection in any cell can arrive.
What it computes is drafted, not built: ADR-0051 (Proposed) names five correlations as folds over facts
and a judgment tier beside them. The reference's correlator computes nothing (D-0051-1). See E3.
read every cell's topic (ACL)
read every cell's topic (ACL)

text.tspan: §2 · The watched-by relation is the ACL

svg.text: For a principal p, W(p) is the set of observer seats whose lease holds a read authorization on p's current round topic: p's cell Observer and the
correlators of p's domain.
A fact in the mechanism's state, evaluated by lookup, syntactic in ADR-0007's sense.
ADR-0039 coupling is written against the relation, not against how it is populated, so either record can be superseded alone.
Not realized at the reference: no per-topic read authorization exists, so cells are declared and not enforced (mechanism/ I8). Operators and
emergency seats add readers that nothing gates: the mechanism has no read path for topics (G10 item 46).

text.tspan: §4 · Placement: ADR-0008's rule, carried forward for seats
seat shares a device with a Thinker it watches.

svg.text: The Reader stage may still colocate: it was never an independent fault domain and is no longer a seat.
The reason no longer rests on a quorum. A shared device means shared driver, firmware, memory error domain, thermal and power events and host
kernel: correlated failure plus an effect path through device memory the model does not include.

text.tspan: One domain (Build or Run) · B2 Contain · ADR-0038 §1
Contain: a finding becomes a deny, a quarantine or an eviction (ADR-0007)

svg.text: Findings are deny-only. No Observer output admits anything; a deny needs no quorum: "consensus for grants, local for denials".
Any-of (§5). A finding from any member of W(p) takes effect, and no agreement is sought. Observers.tla DenyByAnyOf holds; mutation M_QUORUM (a finding counts only with a majority of W(p)) gives a
counterexample: one honest finding suppressed by the other Observer's silence.
Reach is bounded (§1). A cell Observer's finding never blocks an admit outside its cell: ReachIsBounded holds; M_REACH (domain-wide reach for cell Observers) breaks it. Reach is declared and not
enforced at the reference (I8).
Both proved since 2026.10.02 (ADR-0038 B25): Observers_proof.tla, 65 obligations, DenyByAnyOf not under M_QUORUM and ReachIsBounded not under M_REACH. Certified since 2026.10.04
(ADR-0046 A1): 62 obligations rest on normalization or a checked proof, 3 on LS4, which no checker confirms. A proof of the module: reach stays declared, not enforced, at the reference.
More Observers never lower safety and may lower availability: the monotone direction. Each added seat can raise detection if its lineage is independent, and adds a way to raise a false denial.

text.tspan: §6 · The veto roster holds cell Observers and correlators (Build)

svg.text: ADR-0024 §5's veto-seat holder becomes every cell Observer seat and every correlator seat in the Build domain (ADR-0024 A2, in force; ToO §5.1). The reference seats o1 in a1's cell and corr, both on the roster.
A veto seat's alphabet is unchanged: Vote(deny) only. A correlator's Vote(grant) is refused; its silence is not a veto (ADR-0024 §2).

ADR-0035 §5's tally condition (a veto seat with a Persona independent of the author's) is met by the author's cell Observer by construction under seat distinctness, or by an independent correlator. A2.2 is not checked by the reference
"One compromised seat is a veto until the anchor reissues the roster" applies to a correlator as written.
findings from any member of W(p): deny-only
Vote(deny) from veto seats (Build)

text.tspan: Since G9: what a cell Observer is given, who else reads a round topic, and who is not coupled
What a cell Observer is given (ADR-0043 §4 A1, Batch 34)

svg.text: The labels: the Actuate record's envelope carries inputLabels, resultLabel, delivery and clearSet
The payload in full, whatever was delivered to the Thinker: suppressed to the Thinker is not suppressed
to the Observer (ADR-0047 §5).
Its Thinker's tool list, from the round's opening record, read under W(p) (ADR-0048 §2). It has no
sequence number, so the mark does not assert it was read.
An item delivered to an observer seat as a handle makes it a facts-only reader for that item, and the
deployment declares it (ADR-0038 §3).

text.tspan: An emergency seat is not coupled to an Observer (ADR-0039 A2; ADR-0052 §4)

svg.text: R3-observer-live is a forbid on a thinker seat; an emergency seat is not one, so no exemption is
written. What goes uncoupled is a person, seated by a quorum, for one round.
Its topic is read by the domain's operators, who are in its W(p), by a cell Observer if one is seated and
live, and by the correlator, as every topic in its domain. A finding is a deny any of them can make.
G10 item 49, "break-glass under a dead Observer", is decided on this provisional basis.
Every control action is written to the operator's round topic, and every other operator in the domain is in
its W(p). A finding is a deny: a revocation or an end of round, under the finder's signature.
An add needs a live peer: the shape of R3 applied to people. It couples to a peer's presence, not to
anything the peer has read; there is no watermark (G10 §8).
At the reference nothing gates who reads these topics (item 46).

text.tspan: Built at reference · in a test

svg.text: Built, for labels (ADR-0047 §11), in a test: e2e.rs
labels_bound_what_a_round_may_send_after_what_it_has_read, with a scripted Observer
heartbeat so the Thinker's effects are coupled.
It is a test fixture. The Observer that would produce a finding is still an e2e fixture with nothing behind it:
the reference seats one, hears its heartbeats and stalls on its absence (ToO §15).
A scripted correlator is not built (ADR-0051 §10; item 97).

text.tspan: §1 · The archetype has an Observer per cell and a correlator across cells

svg.text: One observer seat per cell (ADR-0037 §2)
Its cell's Thinker
The Thinker's round topic, payloads included, under the ACL (0003.3)
One cell's detection
One or more observer seats that belong to no cell
Every cell in its domain
§3: facts, typed envelopes and payloads (below)
Cross-cell detection only; every cell Observer still works

text.tspan: §3 · What the correlator reads at the archetype: everything the shared group could

svg.text: Facts from every cell: admits and denials with principal, lease, epoch and per-principal sequence number (topak-seq, extended to denials: finding 2, item 44, still open; ADR-0051 §5, Proposed, would place a denial by its

at instead); cell Observers' findings as control-plane facts; the Reader stage's facts for every Persona declaring topk_logprobs (R1); lease grants, renewals, revocations and seals. A cross-cell drift in distance is a
substitution signal no single cell can see.
Typed action envelopes: variant, reference, target or tool, principal. Which Draft and Invoke fields are control-plane is ADR-0022's open follow-up.
Payloads of every cell's round topics, under the ACL.

text.tspan: Facts-only correlator: a deployment's narrowing, not the archetype

svg.text: Facts only: a permitted narrowing, recorded as the mitigation on D-0038-2's declaration (ADR-0023 §6).
Gives up cross-cell semantic detection: the fragmentation case of Makins et al. (09.16 review CR-3).
Gains: an injection in one cell's content reaches the correlator only through a fixed-schema fact.
The archetype does not take the trade: it does not give up capability (ADR-0023 §3).

text.tspan: §7 · Degeneracies on this record (declaration kind; both ratify as record-level entries)

svg.text: Declaration
Cell Observers: one per cell → none, with the correlator kept. This is ADR-0008 as
Every cell has an Observer (ADR-0037 D-0037-1, fleet-wide)

No safety theorem. Each cell's detection falls to the correlator, so one compromised correlator blinds every cell; the bounded injection blast radius is lost. Under ADR-0039, coupling has nothing per cell to
couple to
No participant changes type
Declaration
Correlators: 1 or more → 0
Some Observer reads across cells
No safety theorem. Cross-principal detection is lost: the fragmentation and multi-agent coordination cases (CR-3)
No participant changes type

Composition note (§7a). D-0038-1 with D-0038-2 leaves no Observer at all: no theorem lost beyond the union, every detection claim lost, and in Build nothing promotes (ADR-0035 §5). In Run, D-0038-1 is usable only together with ADR-0039 D-0039-1, since §4 there forbids coupling to the correlator. On the schema (R2): "none" under theorems voided with the loss in prose, because ADR-0023 §6 has no properties-lost field (ADR-0037 finding 6; item 40).
An Observer should come from a different model family than the agents it watches; sharing a family is a
shared blind spot.
Since ADR-0037 the predicate has one pair per cell to cover: (thinker, observer).
Seat distinctness is enforced where refusal stalls, at the tally and the declaration, never at grant
(ADR-0035 §5, Proposed).
Cell Observer: deny, quarantine or evict inside one cell; one cell's detection lost.
Correlator: deny, quarantine or evict inside its domain, attributed; cross-cell detection lost.
Any Observer: a false denial costs availability, never safety. Any-of raises the false-denial rate with every
Observer added.
Collusion (an Observer that finds nothing) is not covered by any of this: ADR-0039 §5. Detection still
fails open against a colluding Observer (G10 §8).

text.tspan: Finding 1 · The correlator has inputs but no function

svg.text: This record says what it reads and what it may do, not what it looks for: the probe-then-exploit signature,
fragmented intent, a chain-depth term (CR-3). Its derived store crosses erasure units (finding 3).
Drafted since G9: ADR-0051, Proposed, five correlations as folds a second reader can recompute and
an unspecified judgment tier; Correlator.tla proved and certified. Not built at the reference (G10
items 43, 97). Drawn in E3.
Chain depth is not among them: no record models a chain.
An Observer quorum, each seat a BFT group: rejected. A quorum is for grants; for denials it can only
suppress an honest finding, and costs the most instances.
The correlator as a new seat kind: rejected; its reach is the ACL.
The correlator as the only veto holder: not taken; the cell Observer read the author's round in full.
Coupling decided here: split to ADR-0039 (custodian, 09.28).
read edge: a read authorization on the round topic (the ACL)
admits written to the round topic
device boundary (fault domain)
finding → deny, quarantine or evict
Vote(deny) on the veto roster
